subject.descriptionZh: 研究法律规范、权利义务、公共权力及法律制度的解释与适用。
subject.descriptionJa: 法規範、権利義務、公権力、法制度の解釈と適用を研究する分野。
subject.descriptionEn: The study of legal norms, rights and duties, public authority, and the interpretation and application of legal institutions.

Law.Civil-Law.subject: Law
Law.Civil-Law.descriptionZh: 研究私人之间的财产关系、债权债务、合同、侵权及相关救济。
Law.Civil-Law.descriptionJa: 私人間の財産関係、債権債務、契約、不法行為および救済を扱う。
Law.Civil-Law.descriptionEn: Private-law relationships involving property, obligations, contracts, torts, and remedies.

Law.Administrative-Law.subject: Law
Law.Administrative-Law.descriptionZh: 研究行政权的法律依据、行政活动、程序、救济与司法控制。
Law.Administrative-Law.descriptionJa: 行政権の法的根拠、行政活動、手続、救済、司法的統制を扱う。
Law.Administrative-Law.descriptionEn: The legal basis of administrative power, administrative action, procedure, remedies, and judicial control.
